title: DreamDrive: Generative 4D Scene Modeling from Street View Images

output_modality.value: 4D scene as hybrid static/dynamic 3D Gaussians, rendered into novel-view driving videos via Gaussian splatting

control_signal.value: A driving trajectory at render time (forward, turn left, stop); an input control image seeds generation; map and object inputs are shown qualitatively for scene control

control_mechanism.value: Video diffusion model makes reference images from the control input; multiview stereo lifts them to 3D Gaussians; trajectory is applied by splatting the scene, not by injection into a network

base_model.value: Pretrained driving video diffusion priors from cited works [11] (nuScenes) and [15] (in-the-wild), a multiview stereo network, and self-supervised hybrid 3D Gaussian splatting

datasets.value: nuScenes (1,000 sequences, about 34,000 key frames) and 20 in-the-wild scenarios curated from Google Street View

metrics.value: FID and FVD for novel-view video; BEV segmentation mIoU for perception augmentation; L2 and collision rate for planning

controllability_evidence.value: Mostly qualitative: renders for different trajectories and map/object edits; claims more precise trajectory control than direct video generation. Quality: FID 45.59, FVD 374.02 versus 65.29 and 450.43 for Deformable Gaussians

closed_loop.value: not stated in packet; planning use is trajectory optimisation by 4D collision checks scored with L2 and collision metrics, no interactive policy rollout described

notes: Control is geometric (render along a trajectory), not learned conditioning. Controllability is shown qualitatively, no action-following metric in packet. Which video diffusion models are [11] and [15] is not given in the packet text.
